label: Screening plus verification
subgoals: Multiply candidates by the accurate time for the baseline
Add surrogate time for all candidates and accurate time for the verified fraction
Divide the baseline by the new total

label: Amortizing the build cost
subgoals: Convert the build cost to the loop's time unit
Divide it by the number of campaigns sharing the model
Add the share to the loop time and recompute the speedup

label: The whole-flow bound
subgoals: Measure the replaced step's share of flow runtime
Compute one over the untouched share plus the accelerated share
Report the bound as one over the untouched share
